title: ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on a −170 favourite. It won 23-6. #AI #ChatGPT #NFL
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on the Buffalo Bills moneyline at −170 (Buffalo Bills @ Minnesota Vikings). Its reason, from the public ledger: "Buffalo is listed at -170 here while an external preview showed -185, so I am taking the better listed price at minimum size."
Final: Buffalo Bills 23, Minnesota Vikings 6. ChatGPT won C$1,765.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs X-SPT-035 and X-SPT-036 at PaperTrades.AI
